name: Reef Star Shrine — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Coral-limestone/ivory star shrine with radiating pointed roof/gable forms, small gold finials, shell capitals, central stepped entry and shallow tidal pool surround. Coral-like branches appear as architectural ornament and reef context, not proven living organism assets. Hidden layout inference: One raised reef path meets a dry arrival step, then a small star court beneath the pointed canopy. A low viewing ring watches tidal pools and returns to shore; maintain a clear dry route rather than putting every stair below water. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B24-DETAIL-001 — Reef Star Shrine — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need star-plan wall/canopy wedges, shell capital/column seats, radial stair and dry-path/reef joins. Reuse source gold finials/tidal-rock vocabulary. Seagrass/seaweed are flora; actual living coral/polyps, fish and crustaceans are fauna, separate from coral-shaped stone carving. Tidal support unverified. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
